title: http-vhosts
author: Carlos Pantelides
description: Searches for web virtual hostnames by making a large number of HEAD requests against http servers using common hostnames. Each HEAD request provides a different Host header. The hostnames come from a built-in default list. Shows the names that return a document. Also shows the location of redirections. The domain can be given as the http-vhosts.domain argument or deduced from the target's name. For example when scanning www.example.com, various names of the form .example.com are tried.
